source_corner: FF -40 C 0.99 V; CBEST_T cells, stacked nominal-RC CDAC, ideal SAR intercell wires
frame: fourth frame; gain-normalized input center 64, after center 63
time_origin: Latest of the four physical 50% switch-gate crossings on bit 7 and bit 6 from trial 0x80 to 0x40
data_origin: 5 ps recorded native PSF samples; summary uses linear interpolation at each edge
sensitivity_formula: beta[i]=independently measured differential bit weight[i]/(2*0.9 V); pol is +1 except bit 6. Rail term = sum(beta*pol)*(VREFP-VREFN-0.9). Plate term = sum(beta*((Pmean-Nmean)-pol*(VREFP-VREFN))). Remainder = TOPP-TOPN - static prediction - rail - plate. Switched-terminal weighting is a linear attribution; the remainder includes unmodeled effects.
units: TOP values and reference rails are in mV. Raw excerpt gate, clock, plate-mean and source voltage columns are in V.
